steps.what: List unnamed availability for games and seasons
Plan strategies for individual games
Choose team members for the sports seasons
Sign the season choice
File the signed season choice
outputs: filed copy of signed season choice v1

tasks.design: A job in {CALENDAR} lists unnamed availability for games and seasons and writes no rank. The coach plans the strategies and chooses the team members. A later job files the signed choice in {DOCS}. The job does not choose a person.
tasks.previous_blocker: Availability was asked for in separate messages.
tasks.enabler_now: Game date and unnamed slot are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The choice of members stays with the coach.
tasks.altitude: The coach spends the week on the strategy, not on listing slots.

reach.task: Play only in the game the coach signed

evidence.claim: The executive digest says casting, game strategy, and judging artistry stay with people.
Digest [S11] says a system that filters or evaluates candidates, including for self-employment, is high-risk. This design does not filter or rank candidates.
Digest [S12] says those duties apply from 2 December 2027.
The executive digest says ranking players to sign fits that high-risk reading. This design does not rank players.

assumptions: Game date and an unnamed availability slot are stored on the season record. The season record produces them. A blank date is not a game. The list names no player and is not a ranking.
Native configuration of the season record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the coach signed is filed or sent.
Choosing team members is the coach's decision, not a stored score.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the coach planning strategies for individual games.

incremental.description: Refresh game date and unnamed slot when the season layout changes, and drop a choice the coach has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many game dates are blank. The high end assumes game date and unnamed slot are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Compare academic grades with the stored threshold
Monitor academic eligibility of student athletes
Decide eligibility when a grade is blank
Sign the eligibility decision
File the signed eligibility decision
outputs: filed copy of signed eligibility decision v1

tasks.design: A job in {ERP} compares the stored academic grade with the stored threshold and does not treat a blank as eligible. The coach monitors eligibility and decides. A later job files the signed decision in {DOCS}. It is not a score of the student.
tasks.previous_blocker: Grades were rechecked against a handwritten threshold.
tasks.enabler_now: Student identifier, grade, and threshold are already stored.
tasks.human_edge: The coach decides when a grade is missing.

ambition.what: Sign the eligibility decision the day the stored grade and the stored threshold differ.

tasks.altitude: The coach spends the week on the decision, not on the comparison.

reach.task: Accept only the decision the coach signed

evidence.claim: The executive digest says scoring and scheduling are not listed.
Digest [S16] says injury notes are health data. This design does not read injury notes and does not automate a health judgement.

assumptions: Student identifier, grade, and threshold are stored on the academic record. The academic record produces them. A student is eligible only when the stored grade meets the stored threshold. A blank grade or a blank threshold is not eligible.
Native configuration of the academic record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the coach signed is filed or sent.
The comparison is not a ranking and not a health judgement.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the coach monitoring academic eligibility of student athletes.

incremental.description: Refresh student identifier, grade, and threshold when the academic layout changes, and drop a decision the coach has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many grades or thresholds are blank. The high end assumes student identifier, grade, and threshold are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List stored appointment slots with no health text
Counsel student athletes on academic issues
Discuss athletic and personal issues in person
Sign the counseling note
File the signed counseling note
outputs: filed copy of signed counseling note v1

tasks.design: A job in {CALENDAR} lists appointment slots and does not read injury text. The coach counsels the student athletes on academic, athletic, and personal issues. A later job files the signed note in {DOCS}. It does not send the note and it does not judge health.
tasks.previous_blocker: Counseling notes were easy to mix with injury notes.
tasks.enabler_now: Appointment date and issue type are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The conversation stays with the coach.
tasks.human_edge: The coach decides what to say.
tasks.altitude: The coach spends the week in the conversation, not on listing slots.

reach.task: Hear only what the coach says in person

evidence.claim: Digest [S16] says injury notes are health data. This design does not read injury notes and does not automate a health judgement.
Digest [S17] says tracking a club's own players needs works council consent. This design does not build a tracking dashboard.

assumptions: Appointment date and issue type are stored on the counseling record. The counseling record produces them. A row whose stored type is injury is left out and its text is not read. A blank issue type is not a counseling topic. Filing the note does not send it.
Native configuration of the counseling record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the coach signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the coach counseling student athletes on academic issues.

incremental.description: Refresh appointment date and issue type when the counseling layout changes, and drop a note the coach has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many issue types are blank. The high end assumes appointment date and issue type are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List stored opposing team notes with no score
Analyze strengths and weaknesses of opposing teams
Develop game strategies from those notes
Sign the game strategy
File the signed game strategy
outputs: filed copy of signed game strategy v1

tasks.design: A job in {DOCS} lists stored notes on opposing teams and writes no score. The coach analyzes the strengths and weaknesses and develops the game strategies. A later job files the signed strategy. Strategy stays with the coach.
tasks.previous_blocker: Opponent notes were scattered across matches.
tasks.enabler_now: Opponent name and match date are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The strategy is still the coach's.
tasks.human_edge: The coach decides the game plan.
tasks.altitude: The coach spends the week on the strategy, not on listing notes.

reach.task: Follow only the strategy the coach signed

evidence.claim: The executive digest says casting, game strategy, and judging artistry stay with people.

assumptions: Opponent name and match date are stored on the opponent record. The opponent record produces them. A blank opponent name is not analyzed. The list is not a ranking of the coach's own athletes.
Native configuration of the opponent record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the coach signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the coach analyzing strengths and weaknesses of opposing teams.

incremental.description: Refresh opponent name and match date when the opponent layout changes, and drop a strategy the coach has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many opponent names are blank. The high end assumes opponent name and match date are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

role.altitude: The coach spends the week on the field, with the athletes, and on the signed note. A stored list, an unnamed slot, and filing that signature can move. The coach still runs the session, chooses the people, and signs the note.
reach: An athlete trains only on the session the coach signed.
A parent sees only the note the coach signed.
skills_to_grow: Reject a schedule that names a player the coach did not assign.
Reject a scouting claim that does not restate a stored note.
Reject a letter or an order the coach has not signed.
role.ambitious_version: A signed schedule or report can be filed the same day, and the coach still owns the field.
